ambiguities.text: The specific types of requests that contribute to requests_hash are not enumerated in this module
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-7685 defines the request types (e.g., validator deposits, withdrawals, consolidations). Verify against EIP-7685 specification.

ambiguities.text: The ommers field is described as 'always empty in Proof-of-Stake forks' but it's unclear if validation still requires ommers to be present as empty tuple
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume ommers must be present as empty tuple and ommers_hash must equal hash of empty list. This maintains backwards compatibility.

ambiguities.text: The interaction between parent_beacon_block_root and the beacon chain is mentioned but not fully specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume parent_beacon_block_root is provided by the consensus layer and must match the beacon block that corresponds to this execution block.

implicit_assumptions.description: The beacon chain provides valid and authentic withdrawal data that cannot be forged
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Forged withdrawals could allow attackers to credit arbitrary amounts to arbitrary addresses, inflating supply

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution layer correctly implements the Engine API to receive block data from consensus layer
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect Engine API implementation could cause consensus split between execution and consensus layers

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot manipulate block timestamps or numbers to bypass validation rules
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Timestamp manipulation could affect time-dependent contracts or difficulty/gas calculations

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes upgrade to support EIP-7702 SetCodeTransaction type before Prague activation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes without EIP-7702 support would reject valid blocks containing type-4 transactions, causing chain split
